rules.quote: Use language that is culturally appropriate and respectful of the diversity of Australia’s peoples.
rules.specification: This is a general inclusive-language requirement. The page does not define which expressions are culturally inappropriate or disrespectful; operational criteria require the topic-specific guidance and relevant cultural context.
rules.violation_condition: Wording is culturally inappropriate or expresses disrespect for the diversity of Australia’s peoples.
rules.why: Retains the general requirement; G-6 assigns the topic-specific summaries to their respective subject pages.
